title: feat(mcp): serve list_datasets and query_dataset over MCP under data:read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9DiJcGW3TmZrvWPuvNopKmm)_

Fixes #31590

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP 新增 `list_datasets` / `query_dataset` 两个只读工具(`data:read` 范围),HTTP 与 stdio 两条桥都接到 service-analytics 的数据集执行器;生成的 SKILL.md 教客户端「先查数据集、精确命中才用指标、多义先问、无命中退回对象查询并注明非指标口径」。
- 为什么改:ADR-0149 D2/D3 —— 外部 AI 客户端与产品内问数用同一套数据集工具、同一口径,答案带出处。
- 风险与回滚:纯新增;没有 analytics 服务(或服务不带 `datasetTools`)的部署工具列表与现在完全一样;不带 `data:read` 的令牌看不到这两个工具。回滚即 revert 本 PR。依赖 #31589 合入后才真正有服务端可调。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `registerDatasetTools`(注册条件与范围门)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` 的 `datasetToolMembers`(数据集读取、本地化、按调用者身份执行)、`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` 的选择规则文案。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-dataset-tools.test.ts`,预期 20 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(在 #31589 之后)。

## What changes

- **Bridge members (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`).** `McpDataBridge` gains three optional members: `listDatasets(input)`, `queryDataset(input, { maxRows })` and `datasetToolDefinitions()`. The third carries the service-analytics definitions, so this package holds no copy of the tool descriptions (seat ruling 1, the third member accepted by the seat).
- **`registerDatasetTools`, called from `wireBridgeTools`.** Registers `list_datasets` / `query_dataset` only when the bridge carries all three members AND the grant admits `data:read` (`grantedScopes` undefined keeps them, as every read tool). Name from the spec constants, description from the bridge's definitions (a tool the definitions do not describe is not registered), input schema = the spec declaration `ListDatasetsInputSchema` / `QueryDatasetInputSchema` taken whole (the precedent: `aggregate_records` takes `AggregationNodeSchema` whole), so an undeclared key is refused before dispatch with the spec's prescription. `query_dataset` hands the tool's page cap (`maxQueryLimit`, default 50, the `query_records` cap) to the bridge. Refusals render through `errorResultWithCode`, the coded envelope the other data tools use. Annotations: read-only, not destructive, closed world.
- **HTTP bridge (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`).** `handleMcpRequest` resolves the `analytics` service per request; the bridge carries the three members only when it has `datasetTools` (seat ruling C: `AnalyticsService.datasetTools(deps)` from #31589). The executor is bound to: the saved datasets from the protocol's merged `getMetaItems({ type: 'dataset' })` (the read the REST door resolves `datasetName` from), localized with `translateMetaList` for the request's locale; the request's security service as the narrowing probe; and the tool's page cap. Every call runs as the request's `ExecutionContext`. A throwing dataset read reaches the executor as a throw (its degraded-read answer), never as an empty catalogue. The `/mcp/skill` route renders the dataset section exactly where the bridge would carry the pair.
- **stdio bridge (`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`, `plugin.ts`).** `createStdioDataBridge` takes an optional `datasetTools` service; the plugin resolves it in `start()` (all services are registered by then, and the tools must be registered before the transport attaches). Datasets come from the protocol's merged read, or the metadata service's `list('dataset')` on a host with none; calls run as the stdio principal, re-resolved per call.
- **SKILL.md (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`).** New `datasetTools` render option (the `fileTools` pattern): the two tool entries and the D3 selection rule render only when the host's bridge carries the pair and the grant admits `data:read`.
- Changeset: patch for `@objectstack/mcp` and `@objectstack/runtime`.
- Not touched: the existing tool shapes (`run_action` / `list_actions` / `agent_prompt`), E8's by-name readers, `packages/spec/**`, `packages/services/service-analytics/**`, `ui/**`.

## Tests

- New `packages/mcp/src/mcp-dataset-tools.test.ts` (20 cases): registration with all three members; descriptions verbatim from the definitions; input schemas closed; each partial-member case (each one of the three missing, and all three) registers neither tool and leaves the rest of the surface unchanged; a definition missing → that tool absent; `data:read` admits both; a `data:write`-only grant registers neither and a call gets the same unknown-tool refusal as `query_records`, with the bridge never asked; argument pass-through and page cap (default and host `maxQueryLimit`); undeclared key refused before the bridge naming `datasetName`; coded refusal envelope; SKILL.md rendering by bridge and grant; the stdio bridge's members (absent without the executor, run as the stdio principal with the cap, merged read and metadata-service fallback).
- New `packages/runtime/src/mcp-dataset-tools-bridge.test.ts` (6 cases): the seam is served only by an `analytics` service carrying `datasetTools` (absent service and method-absent cases pinned, as the seat asked); no seam → no members; definitions handed over unchanged; both calls run as the request's principal; page cap and narrowing probe bound; a throwing dataset read stays a throw.
- **Forced test edit:** `packages/mcp/src/skill-md-surface-guard.test.ts` — the full-surface bridge gains the three dataset members and the two renders pass `datasetTools: true`, so the drift guard covers the new tools.

## Acceptance notes

- **Lands after #31589.** This branch compiles and passes without it (the service face is declared structurally, as `McpRecordFileService` is), but no deployment serves `datasetTools` until #31589 merges; then merge main here. The MCP row of #31589's four-face parity test is #31589's to fill once both are on main.
- **stdio datasets are not localized.** The stdio transport has no request locale (an API-key principal), so labels come as authored; the HTTP bridge localizes as the REST door does.
- **The stdio bridge passes no narrowing probe**, matching `query_records` on stdio (an API key is not delegated).

## Verification

Head `5078be21` (merge of `origin/main` `f65c36fc` into the card commits; that main commit touches `plugin-webhooks` only), measured in a card container.

- `@objectstack/mcp` test: Test Files 62 passed (62), Tests 979 passed (979).
- `@objectstack/runtime` test: Test Files 564 passed (564), Tests 9065 passed, 19 skipped (9084).
- `@objectstack/mcp` and `@objectstack/runtime` typecheck (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0 on `37710911` (later commits: the changeset and the merge, which brought no file of either package). The runtime reading needed `driver-turso` built first: an untouched kernel test imports it.
- Lint: `eslint --no-inline-config packages/mcp packages/runtime` exit 0.
- Derived gates: 68 derived, 67 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3: it needs every workspace package built; left to CI). `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone and is exit 0 after fetching its pinned fixture commit. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 0 UNRUN.

<details><summary>Red on main: 12 of 17 registration/call pins fail on the origin/main source</summary>

`mcp-http-tools.ts` and `skill-md.ts` restored from `origin/main` `0105a687`, the new test file kept: `Tests 12 failed | 5 passed (17)`. The five that pass are the "no dataset tool" cases, which hold on main by construction. (The three stdio cases were added after this leg.)
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations: four legs, each red, each restored (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

The tests import source directly (no dist leg). Each leg: anchor x1 to x0, marker x0 to x1, run red, restore proved by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- A1 drop the `data:read` gate in `registerDatasetTools`: red `a grant without data:read registers neither…` (1 failed, 16 passed).
- A2 require only `listDatasets` in `hasDatasetTools`: red `a bridge without ["queryDataset"]…` and `…["datasetToolDefinitions"]…` (2 failed).
- A3 serve the HTTP seam from any `analytics` service, method or not: red `the seam is served by an analytics service carrying datasetTools, and not without one` (1 failed, 5 passed).
- A4 attach the stdio members without the executor: red `a bridge built without the analytics executor carries no dataset member` (1 failed, 19 passed).

A1's first attempt used a replacement already present in the file; the tool refused it before running anything (replacement count did not rise) and it was re-run with a marker.
</details>
